searchText: You need 10 or more tb of fast disk (assuming geth). Maybe only 2 tb for eragon. Get takes more than a week. Probably closer to 2 or 3 weeks if not more. Don't know about eragaon or other clients. Why is Geth so much more than eragon/others <@!364458974906548225>? I was also thinking of running an archival node. I just finished syncing a full node and Geth is 466g. Finished in a couple days (not bad). Different architecture I recently synced a full node Geth in <6 hours with snap sync, and 25 hours with fast sync. But I would expect weeks for Geth archive mode sync. The different kinds of sync do very different calculations. Erigon did archive mode sync (no pruning) in 3 days 3 hours on the same system. Erigon took about 1.5TB when it was done, but it's up to 1.7TB now (both numbers rounded to nearest 0.1TB). Please be careful about nomenclature: the big difference is not because of archive vs non-archive. It’s about full validation (executing all blocks) vs just downloading latest state. We at Erigon could (and probably will) make a mode to download current state along with the history. It will be archive, but the sync will be literally as fast as your internet connection.
